WildSpark 2.2.48 is a stable update for WoW Forever 1.60.1.

- Update WildLayer to AutoLayer 1.9.16 and WildFire Kit to 1.10; rename the embedded camping folder to WildFireKitEmbedded.
- Update WildGroups to 2.1.0 and restore chat notices for incoming and outgoing group/raid invites and guild invites. Incoming group invites play the LFG ReadyCheck sound.
- Update WildAuctions to auxForever 0.8.2.1 and fix its full-scan callback, crate tooltip control, and sniper fee calculation.
- Keep WildPvP integrated as a WildSpark module with its own tab. Its combat features are limited to battlegrounds and arenas.
- Keep WildMaps in the movable Zone Map. The map stays clipped to its viewport and zoom cannot shrink below the fitted full-map view.
- Add clearly labeled local drop-rate estimates from observed looted corpses when no published rate is available. WildInfo no longer registers the restricted combat-log event.
- Preserve immediate module switches and the scrollable module tab rail.

The release package passed automated packaging and ZIP integrity checks. Live in-game behavior was not validated for this release.
